selectionMethodology.method: Bounded reference sample from prior public first-party references plus provider-domain lifecycle and non-lifecycle searches; inspect full primary pages independently before gold admission; deduplicate canonical URL and semantic kind; retain unreviewed references in MANUAL_REVIEW. No selection based on measured parser success.
selectionMethodology.representativeness: Exploratory purposive sample, not random provider population sample. All manually curated references disclosed.
selectionMethodology.knownUrlPolicy: Reference URLs are never passed as seeds to generic production discovery; direct-URL diagnostic uses a separate fetch/cache.
limitations: CORPUS_INDEPENDENCE_LIMITATION for unreviewed historical references; they are excluded
CORPUS_TOO_SMALL when fewer than8 confirmed positives
No forced cancellation examples; unknown publication dates explicitly omitted from gold-known fields
All provider positive samples below8; no statistically representative provider rating. Negative samples below5; retain safety sample limitations rather than fabricate filler.
Apple repeated-series longitudinal sample intentionally exercises season and date binding; seven announcements across two series do not represent the whole provider population.
